name: Amplemarket
tagline: Amplemarket automates outreach, lead research, and pipeline generation for B2B sales teams. It enriches prospect data, writes personalized email sequences, and tracks engagement signals to prioritize follow-up. Teams use it to cut the manual work of building and working a pipeline so reps spend more time in actual conversations.
